title: Reverse a string
answer: static String reverse(String s) { return new StringBuilder(s).reverse().toString(); }
explanation: StringBuilder reverses the UTF-16 char sequence in O(n) time.

title: Check whether a string is a palindrome
explanation: Case-insensitive; spaces and punctuation are still considered. Normalize them if required.

title: Check whether a number is prime
explanation: Tests odd divisors only through sqrt(n), O(√n).

title: Print all prime numbers between 1 and N
explanation: Sieve of Eratosthenes, approximately O(n log log n).

explanation: BigInteger prevents integer overflow.

title: Generate the Fibonacci series
explanation: Returns the first count terms starting at 0. Long eventually overflows.

title: Check whether a number is an Armstrong number
explanation: For example, 153 = 1³ + 5³ + 3³.

title: Check whether a number is a palindrome
explanation: Negative values are treated as non-palindromes; zero is a palindrome.

title: Swap two numbers without a third variable
answer: static int[] swap(int a,int b) { a^=b; b^=a; a^=b; return new int[]{a,b}; }
explanation: XOR works for integers but a temporary variable is usually clearer in production code.

title: Find the greatest of three numbers
answer: static int maxOfThree(int a,int b,int c) { return Math.max(a,Math.max(b,c)); }
explanation: Uses the standard Math.max method.

title: Sum the digits of a number
explanation: Casting to long handles Integer.MIN_VALUE safely; zero returns 0.

title: Count the digits in a number
explanation: The sign is not counted; zero has one digit.

title: Reverse an integer
explanation: Uses long during reversal and detects int overflow.

title: Find GCD and LCM of two numbers
answer:
static long gcd(long a,long b){a=Math.abs(a);b=Math.abs(b);while(b!=0){long r=a%b;a=b;b=r;}return a;}
static long lcm(long a,long b){return a==0||b==0?0:Math.abs((a/gcd(a,b))*b);}
explanation: Euclid’s algorithm computes GCD. LCM may overflow long for very large values.

title: Convert decimal to binary
answer: static String toBinary(int n) { return Integer.toBinaryString(n); }
explanation: Negative integers use Java’s 32-bit two’s-complement representation.

title: Find duplicate characters in a string
explanation: LinkedHashSet preserves the order in which duplicates are first detected.

title: Find the first non-repeating character
explanation: Returns Optional.empty() when every character repeats.

title: Find the first repeating character
explanation: Scans left-to-right and returns the first character encountered for a second time.

title: Count occurrences of each character
explanation: Counts Java char values; use codePoints() for full Unicode code-point handling.

title: Check whether two strings are anagrams
explanation: Ignores case and whitespace, but not punctuation. O(n log n).

title: Remove duplicate characters from a string
explanation: Keeps first occurrences in original order.

title: Count vowels and consonants in a string
explanation: Returns {vowels, consonants}; ignores non-English letters, digits, and punctuation.

title: Reverse each word in a sentence
explanation: Preserves runs of spaces through empty split elements.

title: Reverse the order of words in a sentence
explanation: Normalizes whitespace to single spaces.

title: Find the longest word in a sentence
explanation: Returns an Optional because the input may contain no words.

title: Find the longest substring without repeating characters
explanation: Sliding window, O(n) time. Returns the length.

title: Find all permutations of a string
answer:
static List<String> permutations(String s){List<String> out=new ArrayList<>(); permute(s.toCharArray(),0,out); return out;}
static void permute(char[] a,int i,List<String> out){if(i==a.length){out.add(new String(a));return;} for(int j=i;j<a.length;j++){char t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;permute(a,i+1,out);t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;}}
explanation: O(n!) outputs; repeated input characters can produce duplicate permutations.

title: Check whether one string is a rotation of another
answer: static boolean isRotation(String a,String b){return a!=null&&b!=null&&a.length()==b.length()&&(a+a).contains(b);}
explanation: Equal length plus substring-of-doubled-string check.

title: Find the most frequent character in a string
explanation: An empty string returns Optional.empty().

title: Remove all whitespace from a string
answer: static String removeWhitespace(String s){return s.replaceAll("\\s+","");}
explanation: For specialized Unicode whitespace requirements, use an explicit character predicate.

title: Count words in a sentence
answer: static int countWords(String s){String t=s.trim();return t.isEmpty()?0:t.split("\\s+").length;}
explanation: Treats whitespace sequences as separators.

title: Find duplicate words in a sentence
explanation: Ignores case and punctuation; returns each duplicated word once.

title: Compress a string using character counts
explanation: Example: aaabbc → a3b2c1. The compressed form can be longer than the input.

title: Check whether a string contains only digits
answer: static boolean onlyDigits(String s){if(s==null||s.isEmpty())return false;for(char c:s.toCharArray())if(!Character.isDigit(c))return false;return true;}
explanation: Character.isDigit includes Unicode digits. Use ASCII comparisons if required.

title: Find the longest palindromic substring
explanation: Expand-around-center algorithm: O(n²) time and O(1) extra space.

title: Find the largest and smallest elements in an array
answer: static int[] minMax(int[] a){if(a.length==0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("empty array");int min=a[0],max=a[0];for(int n:a){min=Math.min(min,n);max=Math.max(max,n);}return new int[]{min,max};}
explanation: One pass: O(n) time, O(1) extra space.

title: Find the second-largest element in an array
answer: static OptionalInt secondLargest(int[] a){int max=0,second=0;boolean hm=false,hs=false;for(int x:a){if(!hm||x>max){if(hm){second=max;hs=true;}max=x;hm=true;}else if(x<max&&(!hs||x>second)){second=x;hs=true;}}return hs?OptionalInt.of(second):OptionalInt.empty();}
explanation: Returns the second distinct-largest value; OptionalInt.empty() if it does not exist.

title: Find the second-smallest element in an array
answer: static OptionalInt secondSmallest(int[] a){int min=0,second=0;boolean hm=false,hs=false;for(int x:a){if(!hm||x<min){if(hm){second=min;hs=true;}min=x;hm=true;}else if(x>min&&(!hs||x<second)){second=x;hs=true;}}return hs?OptionalInt.of(second):OptionalInt.empty();}
explanation: Returns the second distinct-smallest value.

title: Reverse an array in place
answer: static void reverse(int[] a){for(int i=0,j=a.length-1;i<j;i++,j--){int t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;}}
explanation: Two pointers, O(n) time and O(1) extra space.

title: Sort an array without built-in sorting methods
answer: static void bubbleSort(int[] a){for(int i=0;i<a.length-1;i++){boolean changed=false;for(int j=0;j<a.length-1-i;j++)if(a[j]>a[j+1]){int t=a[j];a[j]=a[j+1];a[j+1]=t;changed=true;}if(!changed)break;}}
explanation: Bubble sort: O(n²) worst-case time; early exit helps nearly sorted inputs.

title: Remove duplicates from an array
answer: static int[] unique(int[] a){return Arrays.stream(a).distinct().toArray();}
explanation: Streams preserve encounter order for an ordered int stream.

title: Find duplicate elements in an array
answer: static Set<Integer> duplicates(int[] a){Set<Integer> seen=new HashSet<>(),dup=new LinkedHashSet<>();for(int x:a)if(!seen.add(x))dup.add(x);return dup;}
explanation: Expected O(n) time using hash sets.

title: Find the missing number from 1 to N
answer: static int missingNumber(int[] a,int n){long expected=(long)n*(n+1)/2;for(int x:a)expected-=x;return Math.toIntExact(expected);}
explanation: Assumes values are distinct and exactly one value from 1..N is missing.

title: Find pairs whose sum equals a target
answer: static List<int[]> twoSumPairs(int[] a,int target){List<int[]> out=new ArrayList<>();Set<Integer> seen=new HashSet<>();for(int x:a){int need=target-x;if(seen.contains(need))out.add(new int[]{need,x});seen.add(x);}return out;}
explanation: Expected O(n) time; emits pairs as encountered and can emit value pairs multiple times if duplicates occur.

title: Move all zeros to the end of an array
answer: static void moveZeros(int[] a){int write=0;for(int x:a)if(x!=0)a[write++]=x;while(write<a.length)a[write++]=0;}
explanation: Stable for non-zero elements; O(n) time.

title: Rotate an array to the left by K positions
answer:
static void rotateLeft(int[] a,int k){if(a.length==0)return;k=Math.floorMod(k,a.length);reverseRange(a,0,k-1);reverseRange(a,k,a.length-1);reverseRange(a,0,a.length-1);}
static void reverseRange(int[] a,int l,int r){while(l<r){int t=a[l];a[l++]=a[r];a[r--]=t;}}
explanation: Three reversals, O(n) time and O(1) extra space.

title: Rotate an array to the right by K positions
answer: static void rotateRight(int[] a,int k){if(a.length==0)return;k=Math.floorMod(k,a.length);rotateLeft(a,a.length-k);}
explanation: Reuses left rotation; handles k larger than array length.

title: Merge two sorted arrays
answer: static int[] mergeSorted(int[] a,int[] b){int[] r=new int[a.length+b.length];int i=0,j=0,k=0;while(i<a.length&&j<b.length)r[k++]=a[i]<=b[j]?a[i++]:b[j++];while(i<a.length)r[k++]=a[i++];while(j<b.length)r[k++]=b[j++];return r;}
explanation: Two-pointer merge in O(n+m) time.

title: Find the intersection of two arrays
answer: static int[] intersection(int[] a,int[] b){Set<Integer> s=new HashSet<>();for(int x:a)s.add(x);Set<Integer> out=new LinkedHashSet<>();for(int x:b)if(s.contains(x))out.add(x);return out.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();}
explanation: Returns distinct common values, in the order first seen in the second array.

title: Find the union of two arrays
answer: static int[] union(int[] a,int[] b){Set<Integer> s=new LinkedHashSet<>();for(int x:a)s.add(x);for(int x:b)s.add(x);return s.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();}
explanation: Returns unique values preserving encounter order.

title: Maximum sum of a contiguous subarray
answer: static int maxSubarraySum(int[] a){if(a.length==0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("empty array");int current=a[0],best=a[0];for(int i=1;i<a.length;i++){current=Math.max(a[i],current+a[i]);best=Math.max(best,current);}return best;}
explanation: Kadane’s algorithm: O(n) time; works when all numbers are negative.

title: Find the majority element in an array
answer: static OptionalInt majority(int[] a){int candidate=0,count=0;for(int x:a){if(count==0)candidate=x;count+=x==candidate?1:-1;}count=0;for(int x:a)if(x==candidate)count++;return count>a.length/2?OptionalInt.of(candidate):OptionalInt.empty();}
explanation: Boyer–Moore voting plus verification; majority means more than n/2 occurrences.

title: Find the element that appears once while others appear twice
answer: static int singleNumber(int[] a){int result=0;for(int x:a)result^=x;return result;}
explanation: XOR cancels pairs. Assumes exactly one singleton and all others appear twice.

title: Maximum difference with larger element after smaller one
answer: static OptionalInt maxDifference(int[] a){if(a.length<2)return OptionalInt.empty();int min=a[0],best=Integer.MIN_VALUE;for(int i=1;i<a.length;i++){best=Math.max(best,a[i]-min);min=Math.min(min,a[i]);}return OptionalInt.of(best);}
explanation: One pass. Returns OptionalInt.empty() for fewer than two values.

title: Product of array except self
answer: static long[] productExceptSelf(int[] a){int n=a.length;long[] out=new long[n];Arrays.fill(out,1);long p=1;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){out[i]=p;p*=a[i];}p=1;for(int i=n-1;i>=0;i--){out[i]*=p;p*=a[i];}return out;}
explanation: O(n) time without division. Products may overflow long for large values.

title: Find the equilibrium index of an array
answer: static int equilibriumIndex(int[] a){long total=0,left=0;for(int x:a)total+=x;for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++){if(left==total-left-a[i])return i;left+=a[i];}return -1;}
explanation: Returns the first index where left sum equals right sum, or -1.

title: Sort an array containing only 0s, 1s, and 2s
answer:
static void sort012(int[] a){int low=0,mid=0,high=a.length-1;while(mid<=high){if(a[mid]==0)swap(a,low++,mid++);else if(a[mid]==1)mid++;else if(a[mid]==2)swap(a,mid,high--);else throw new IllegalArgumentException("Only 0, 1, 2 allowed");}}
static void swap(int[] a,int i,int j){int t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;}
explanation: Dutch National Flag algorithm: O(n) time and O(1) space.

title: Longest consecutive sequence in an unsorted array
answer: static int longestConsecutive(int[] a){Set<Integer>s=new HashSet<>();for(int x:a)s.add(x);int best=0;for(int x:s)if(!s.contains(x-1)){int y=x;while(s.contains(y))y++;best=Math.max(best,y-x);}return best;}
explanation: Expected O(n) time. Extreme integer overflow can be avoided with long counters.

title: Find the top K largest elements in an array
answer: static List<Integer> topKLargest(int[] a,int k){if(k<=0)return List.of();PriorityQueue<Integer> q=new PriorityQueue<>();for(int x:a){q.offer(x);if(q.size()>k)q.poll();}List<Integer> r=new ArrayList<>(q);r.sort(Comparator.reverseOrder());return r;}
explanation: Min-heap of size k: O(n log k). Returns fewer than k if the array is shorter.

title: Merge overlapping intervals
answer: static int[][] mergeIntervals(int[][] intervals){if(intervals.length==0)return new int[0][];Arrays.sort(intervals,Comparator.comparingInt(x->x[0]));List<int[]> out=new ArrayList<>();int[] cur=intervals[0].clone();for(int i=1;i<intervals.length;i++){if(intervals[i][0]<=cur[1])cur[1]=Math.max(cur[1],intervals[i][1]);else{out.add(cur);cur=intervals[i].clone();}}out.add(cur);return out.toArray(new int[0][]);}
explanation: Sort by start time, then merge. O(n log n) due to sorting.

title: Count frequency of each element in a list using HashMap
answer: static <T> Map<T,Long> frequency(List<T> list){Map<T,Long> m=new HashMap<>();for(T x:list)m.merge(x,1L,Long::sum);return m;}
explanation: HashMap gives expected O(n) counting time.

title: Find duplicate elements in a list using Collections
answer: static <T> Set<T> duplicates(List<T> list){Set<T> seen=new HashSet<>(),dup=new LinkedHashSet<>();for(T x:list)if(!seen.add(x))dup.add(x);return dup;}
explanation: Works for any type with correct equals() and hashCode().

title: Remove duplicates from a list preserving insertion order
answer: static <T> List<T> distinctInOrder(List<T> list){return new ArrayList<>(new LinkedHashSet<>(list));}
explanation: LinkedHashSet removes duplicates while retaining first occurrence order.

title: Sort a HashMap by its values
explanation: Returns a LinkedHashMap in ascending value order; ties follow the stream sort stability of the source encounter order where defined.

title: Sort employees by salary using Comparator
answer: employees.sort(Comparator.comparing(Employee::getSalary).thenComparing(Employee::getName));
explanation: Assumes Employee has getSalary() and getName(); tie-breaks by name.

title: Group employees by department using Streams
answer: Map<String,List<Employee>> byDepartment=employees.stream().collect(Collectors.groupingBy(Employee::getDepartment));
explanation: groupingBy creates one list per department.

title: Find first non-repeating element in a list
answer: static <T> Optional<T> firstUnique(List<T> list){Map<T,Integer> m=new LinkedHashMap<>();for(T x:list)m.merge(x,1,Integer::sum);return m.entrySet().stream().filter(e->e.getValue()==1).map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst();}
explanation: Preserves first-seen order.

title: Find the intersection of two lists
answer: static <T> List<T> intersection(List<T> a,List<T> b){Set<T> right=new HashSet<>(b);return a.stream().filter(right::contains).distinct().collect(Collectors.toList());}
explanation: Returns distinct values in the order of the first list.

title: Implement an LRU cache using LinkedHashMap
explanation: accessOrder=true tracks least-recently-used order. This implementation is not thread-safe.

title: Find top K most frequent elements
answer: static List<Integer> topKFrequent(int[] a,int k){Map<Integer,Integer> f=new HashMap<>();for(int x:a)f.merge(x,1,Integer::sum);PriorityQueue<Integer> q=new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingInt(f::get));for(int x:f.keySet()){q.offer(x);if(q.size()>k)q.poll();}List<Integer> r=new ArrayList<>(q);r.sort((x,y)->Integer.compare(f.get(y),f.get(x)));return r;}
explanation: Counts frequencies and maintains a size-k min-heap.

title: Filter even numbers from a list using Streams
answer: List<Integer> evens=numbers.stream().filter(n->n%2==0).collect(Collectors.toList());
explanation: filter retains elements matching the predicate.

title: Find duplicate elements in a list using Streams
answer: Set<Integer> seen=new HashSet<>();Set<Integer> duplicates=numbers.stream().filter(n->!seen.add(n)).collect(Collectors.toCollection(LinkedHashSet::new));
explanation: Uses a stateful predicate; for parallel streams, use a different grouping-based approach.

title: Find first non-repeating character using Streams
answer: Optional<Character> first=s.chars().mapToObj(c->(char)c).collect(Collectors.groupingBy(c->c,LinkedHashMap::new,Collectors.counting())).entrySet().stream().filter(e->e.getValue()==1).map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst();
explanation: LinkedHashMap preserves encounter order. This processes UTF-16 char values.

title: Find the second-highest number using Streams
answer: Optional<Integer> second=numbers.stream().distinct().sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).skip(1).findFirst();
explanation: distinct avoids treating duplicate maximum values as the second-highest distinct number.

title: Find maximum and minimum using Streams
answer:
IntSummaryStatistics stats=numbers.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).summaryStatistics();
int max=stats.getMax(), min=stats.getMin();
explanation: For an empty list, max/min default to 0; check stats.getCount() before relying on them.

title: Sort strings by length using Streams
answer: List<String> sorted=words.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingInt(String::length).thenComparing(Comparator.naturalOrder())).collect(Collectors.toList());
explanation: Sorts by length and then alphabetically for equal lengths.

title: Convert a list of strings to uppercase using Streams
answer: List<String> upper=words.stream().map(s->s.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT)).collect(Collectors.toList());
explanation: Locale.ROOT avoids locale-sensitive case conversion surprises.

title: Partition numbers into even and odd using partitioningBy
answer:
Map<Boolean,List<Integer>> parts=numbers.stream().collect(Collectors.partitioningBy(n->n%2==0));
List<Integer> evens=parts.get(true), odds=parts.get(false);
explanation: The true key contains even numbers; false contains odd numbers.

title: Group words by length using groupingBy
answer: Map<Integer,List<String>> byLength=words.stream().collect(Collectors.groupingBy(String::length));
explanation: Creates groups keyed by string length.

title: Calculate sum and average using Streams
answer:
IntSummaryStatistics stats=numbers.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).summaryStatistics();
long sum=stats.getSum(); double average=stats.getAverage();
explanation: Check getCount() when an empty list is possible.

title: Find employee with highest salary using Streams
answer: Optional<Employee> highest=employees.stream().max(Comparator.comparing(Employee::getSalary));
explanation: Optional is empty when the collection is empty.

title: Find top three highest-paid employees using Streams
answer: List<Employee> top3=employees.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparing(Employee::getSalary).reversed()).limit(3).collect(Collectors.toList());
explanation: Returns up to three employees; add a tie-breaker if deterministic ordering is required.

title: Convert a list into a map using Streams
answer: Map<Long,Employee> byId=employees.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(Employee::getId,Function.identity(),(first,duplicate)->first));
explanation: The merge function keeps the first employee when IDs collide. Choose a policy appropriate to the domain.

title: Flatten a nested list using flatMap
answer: List<Integer> flattened=nested.stream().flatMap(Collection::stream).collect(Collectors.toList());
explanation: flatMap converts each inner stream into one combined stream.

title: Find word frequency using Streams
answer:
Map<String,Long> frequency=Arrays.stream(sentence.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).split("\\W+"))
    .filter(w->!w.isEmpty()).collect(Collectors.groupingBy(Function.identity(),Collectors.counting()));
explanation: Splits on non-word characters; Unicode tokenization may need a more specific regex.

title: Implement binary search iteratively
answer: static int binarySearch(int[] a,int target){int l=0,r=a.length-1;while(l<=r){int m=l+(r-l)/2;if(a[m]==target)return m;if(a[m]<target)l=m+1;else r=m-1;}return -1;}
explanation: Requires sorted input. O(log n) time.

title: Implement binary search recursively
answer: static int binarySearch(int[] a,int target,int l,int r){if(l>r)return -1;int m=l+(r-l)/2;if(a[m]==target)return m;return a[m]<target?binarySearch(a,target,m+1,r):binarySearch(a,target,l,m-1);}
explanation: Call with binarySearch(array, target, 0, array.length - 1). Requires sorted input.

title: Implement bubble sort
answer: static void bubbleSort(int[] a){for(int i=0;i<a.length-1;i++){boolean changed=false;for(int j=0;j<a.length-1-i;j++)if(a[j]>a[j+1]){int t=a[j];a[j]=a[j+1];a[j+1]=t;changed=true;}if(!changed)break;}}
explanation: O(n²) worst-case; stable for equal values.

title: Implement selection sort
answer: static void selectionSort(int[] a){for(int i=0;i<a.length-1;i++){int min=i;for(int j=i+1;j<a.length;j++)if(a[j]<a[min])min=j;int t=a[i];a[i]=a[min];a[min]=t;}}
explanation: O(n²) time, O(1) extra space; usually not stable.

title: Implement insertion sort
answer: static void insertionSort(int[] a){for(int i=1;i<a.length;i++){int key=a[i],j=i-1;while(j>=0&&a[j]>key){a[j+1]=a[j];j--;}a[j+1]=key;}}
explanation: O(n²) worst-case, efficient on small or nearly sorted arrays; stable.

title: Implement merge sort
answer: static void mergeSort(int[] a){if(a.length<2)return;int m=a.length/2;int[] l=Arrays.copyOfRange(a,0,m),r=Arrays.copyOfRange(a,m,a.length);mergeSort(l);mergeSort(r);int i=0,j=0,k=0;while(i<l.length&&j<r.length)a[k++]=l[i]<=r[j]?l[i++]:r[j++];while(i<l.length)a[k++]=l[i++];while(j<r.length)a[k++]=r[j++];}
explanation: O(n log n) time and O(n) auxiliary memory.

title: Implement quicksort
answer:
static void quickSort(int[] a,int low,int high){if(low>=high)return;int p=partition(a,low,high);quickSort(a,low,p-1);quickSort(a,p+1,high);}
static int partition(int[] a,int low,int high){int pivot=a[high],i=low;for(int j=low;j<high;j++)if(a[j]<=pivot){int t=a[i];a[i++]=a[j];a[j]=t;}int t=a[i];a[i]=a[high];a[high]=t;return i;}
explanation: Call with quickSort(array, 0, array.length-1). Average O(n log n), worst-case O(n²).

title: Find an element in a rotated sorted array
answer: static int searchRotated(int[] a,int target){int l=0,r=a.length-1;while(l<=r){int m=l+(r-l)/2;if(a[m]==target)return m;if(a[l]<=a[m]){if(a[l]<=target&&target<a[m])r=m-1;else l=m+1;}else{if(a[m]<target&&target<=a[r])l=m+1;else r=m-1;}}return -1;}
explanation: O(log n) when values are distinct; duplicates can require O(n) in the worst case.

title: Find the longest common prefix in strings
answer: static String longestCommonPrefix(String[] a){if(a.length==0)return "";String p=a[0];for(int i=1;i<a.length;i++)while(!a[i].startsWith(p)){p=p.substring(0,p.length()-1);if(p.isEmpty())return "";}return p;}
explanation: Shrinks the candidate prefix until every string starts with it.

title: Solve the Two Sum problem efficiently
answer: static int[] twoSum(int[] a,int target){Map<Integer,Integer> index=new HashMap<>();for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++){int need=target-a[i];if(index.containsKey(need))return new int[]{index.get(need),i};index.put(a[i],i);}return new int[0];}
explanation: Expected O(n) time. Returns indices, or an empty array if no pair exists.

title: Reverse a singly linked list
answer:
static class Node { int value; Node next; Node(int v){value=v;} }
static Node reverseList(Node head){Node prev=null,cur=head;while(cur!=null){Node next=cur.next;cur.next=prev;prev=cur;cur=next;}return prev;}
explanation: Iterative O(n) time, O(1) extra space.

title: Detect a cycle in a linked list
answer: static boolean hasCycle(Node head){Node slow=head,fast=head;while(fast!=null&&fast.next!=null){slow=slow.next;fast=fast.next.next;if(slow==fast)return true;}return false;}
explanation: Floyd’s tortoise-and-hare algorithm uses O(1) extra space.

title: Find the middle node of a linked list
answer: static Node middle(Node head){Node slow=head,fast=head;while(fast!=null&&fast.next!=null){slow=slow.next;fast=fast.next.next;}return slow;}
explanation: For an even number of nodes, returns the second middle node.

title: Check balanced parentheses using a stack
answer: static boolean isBalanced(String s){Deque<Character> st=new ArrayDeque<>();for(char c:s.toCharArray()){if(c=='('||c=='['||c=='{')st.push(c);else if(c==')'||c==']'||c=='}'){if(st.isEmpty())return false;char o=st.pop();if((c==')'&&o!='(')||(c==']'&&o!='[')||(c=='}'&&o!='{'))return false;}}return st.isEmpty();}
explanation: Checks (), [], and {}. Ignores all other characters.
